steps.text: Hey
I found a really good profile
Already?
What kind of profile?
A man around your age
He's name is Laurent
Single, businessman, the kind of person who works all the time and barely has a personal life
He said he would like to spend a little time with a girl
Nothing strange, just a coffee for about an hour
That sounds... kind of sad
He must feel really lonely in his life to ask for that on an app
It happens more often than people think
Some people spend their whole life working and end up with no one to talk to
For them, even one calm hour with someone kind can mean a lot
I think I understand a little better what I am supposed to do now
Not just be pretty and sit there
But actually make him feel less alone for a while
Exactly
And you are naturally good at that
I hope so
I am going to get ready and then I will go
I will keep you updated, okay?
Okay
Good luck {{name:evelyn}}
You will do great
Thank you 😊
1 H 30 LATER
